Name: Sense Quarry
Components: V, S, M ( A slip of paper wishing for peace )
Description: You press your hands together and allow the slip of paper to be burnt, with its ashes forming a wave that washes around you, highlighting the silhouette of any creature within range that is actively fighting or harbours immediate hostile intent toward another creature. You can discern what or who a creature is if you are familiar with their general shape but may not determine the target of their hostility.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the range increases by 100-ft. for each slot level above 2nd.
